water: a part of a picture where the place is blue more than it is red, dark, and not more green than blue
land: a part of a picture that is not water
kind: water or land; each place of a picture has one kind
speck: a small part of one kind, all round with the other kind; a boat on the water, or a pool on the land
island: a part of land with water all round it, not cut by a side of the picture
lake: a part of water with land all round it, not cut by a side of the picture
blob: an island or a lake
print: some numbers for a blob that say its shape; the print of a blob is the same when the picture is near and when it is far
zoom: how many times bigger a thing is in one picture than in an other picture
closer: a picture with a bigger zoom; you see less of the earth in it, and more of each thing
wider: the other of closer
place: where a thing is in a picture; two numbers: the count across from the left, then the count down from the top
guess: a zoom and a place that may be right; a guess is not yet checked
lay: put a picture on an other picture, at a zoom and a place, so the two pictures see the same earth at the same place
kappa: a number that says how well water is on water and land is on land when you lay one picture on an other; 1 is all right, 0 is no better than a chance lay
fit: a guess with a kappa of 0.6 or more
low: with big cells; each cell is a square of many places, and has the kind most of its places have
detail: with small cells, so you see more
same: two pictures are the same when each place has the same kind
frame: the widest picture of a stitch; all places of a stitch are in the places of the frame
stitch: a list of pictures, each with the place and the size it has in the frame
lesson: a thing SLAM saw when a fit was right, kept for the next stitch; a lesson says a zoom that was right, so SLAM tries that zoom first
inside: a closer picture is inside a wider picture when most of it (6 in 10 or more) is on the wider picture when you lay it there
part: some pictures that are joined by fits; a stitch is done when all pictures are one part
confirm: say a guess is right because a second picture says the same; lay the second picture where the guess says it must be, and it fits there
furniture: a part at the foot of a picture that is not the earth: the writing and the name of the maker; you do not use it

how to stitch:
1. for each picture: give each place its kind. a speck takes the kind round it.
2. if two pictures are the same, keep one; say the other is the same.
3. for each picture: find its blobs, and the print of each blob.
4. for each two pictures: when a blob in one has a print like a blob in the other, that gives a guess. the zoom is how many times bigger one blob is than the other. the place is where the middles of the two blobs come on one an other.
5. when many blob pairs give the same guess, check that guess first.
6. to check a guess: lay the closer picture on the wider picture, low first; then with more detail, only near the guess; at each step try a zoom a small bit bigger and a small bit smaller. say the kappa.
7. a picture with no fit from its blobs: lay it on each other picture, low, at each zoom; the zooms of the lessons first. then check the best three, with more detail.
8. a fit at a zoom of 1.5 or more is right only if the closer picture is inside the wider picture. a far picture can look like a small part of a near picture by chance; then most of it is not on the near picture, and it is not inside.
9. if the pictures are more than one part: lay each picture of the smallest part on each picture of the other parts, both ways round. the best fit joins the two parts. a fit with a kappa from 0.45 to 0.6 can join only when a second picture of the small part confirms it, with a kappa of 0.5 or more. do it again till there is one part, or no fit is good.
10. keep the fits with the biggest kappa that join all the pictures, with no ring; the widest picture is the frame.
11. say the stitch: each picture, at its place in the frame, its size, how much closer it is, and its kappa.
12. keep a lesson for each fit: its zoom, and the way it was found (blobs, or a search).
